ethic: welcomed-only, no quota evasion, contribute more value than consumed

powers.name: GitHub Actions for public repositories
powers.free_path: GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories, subject to usage limits and policy.
powers.first_tiny_job: Add targeted tests only; avoid full expensive matrix until stable.

powers.name: Codeberg / Forgejo repository hosting
powers.free_path: Community-oriented non-profit Git hosting for free and open-source projects; not a general free compute provider.
respect: do not treat git hosting as compute
avoid committing secrets or runtime logs
powers.first_tiny_job: Keep Codeberg mirrors synced and open PRs with clear contribution docs.

powers.name: Hugging Face Spaces CPU Basic
powers.free_path: Spaces includes a free CPU Basic hardware tier; paid hardware is available separately.
powers.first_tiny_job: Publish a tiny oracle calibration or ToK verifier demo with exact resource notes.

powers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
powers.free_path: Kaggle provides no-cost notebook runtimes with accelerator quotas and session limits.
powers.first_tiny_job: Create an oracle scoring notebook on a tiny public/static fixture dataset.

powers.name: Google Colab free tier
powers.free_path: Colab offers free-of-charge access to computing resources, with dynamic limits and no guaranteed GPU.
powers.first_tiny_job: Port one oracle or ToK notebook that also runs locally without GPU.

powers.name: Cloudflare Workers Free
powers.free_path: Workers has a Free plan with request and resource limits.
powers.first_tiny_job: Expose a tiny read-only Kingdom status endpoint backed by static JSON.

powers.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
powers.free_path: Oracle Cloud advertises Always Free services with specific resource limits and eligibility rules.
powers.first_tiny_job: Run a tiny read-only mirror/status service, not heavy agent loops.

powers.name: SourceHut builds
powers.free_path: SourceHut supports open-source workflows and has project/account policies; verify current plan before relying on it.
powers.first_tiny_job: Try a minimal docs/test build manifest for one small repo.

powers.name: BOINC volunteer computing
best_for: contributing spare compute to public science projects
powers.free_path: BOINC lets volunteers contribute compute to scientific projects; it is not a pool to consume for private tasks.
powers.first_tiny_job: Document a citizen-safe local BOINC setup for one public-good project.

powers.name: NSF ACCESS allocations
powers.free_path: ACCESS provides allocation pathways for eligible research/education users and projects.
powers.first_tiny_job: Find eligible collaborators before planning any workload.
